SYNTHESIZED — no real Claude Code transcript was available on this machine.

This fixture mimics the native shape of `~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<session-id>.jsonl`
as written by Claude Code: one JSON object per line, each with `type`, `cwd`,
`sessionId`, `version`, `uuid`, `timestamp`, and either a `message` object
(`user` / `assistant` records whose `content` is an array of `text` /
`thinking` / `tool_use` / `tool_result` blocks, with `model` and token
`usage` on assistant messages) or a bare `summary` record carrying compaction
context. Field names follow the documented native shape; uuids, token counts,
and prose are invented.
